_activity: Name it, define it, point to it
intro: Pick the best one. Hints are here if you want them.

items.stem: Which one names the exact enduring issue Document 1 shows?

options.1: Power & Its Abuse, because the landowners who ran Parliament used their power to remake farming
options.2: The Agricultural Revolution, because landowners tried fertilizers and new tools like the drill seeder
options.3: Scarcity, because Britain did not have enough food for all of its people before the new farming
options.4: Abuse of Power, because the landowners who ran Parliament used that power to serve their own incomes

hints: One of these is the umbrella, not the issue under it.
One of these is the topic of the document, not an issue on the card.
items.reason: Option 1 is the umbrella. Option 2 is the topic. Option 3 is an issue Document 1 never shows. Option 4 names the exact issue and says how the document shows it.

items.stem: Which one defines the issue in Document 8 the way the card does?

options.1: Scientific and Technological Change: Ure wrote that steam engines drain the pits and raise the coals
options.2: Scientific and Technological Change: new tools, like the steam engine, change how people live and work
options.3: Scientific and Technological Change: new inventions are good for everyone because they make life easier
options.4: Wealth & Resources: steam engines made cheap goods and brought in comforts from foreign lands

hints: A definition says what the issue is, not what the document says.
Is option 3 a definition, or an opinion?
items.reason: Option 1 is evidence, not a definition. Option 3 is an opinion. Option 4 names an umbrella. Option 2 defines the issue in the card's own words, with an example.

items.stem: Economic Development shows up in Document 5. Which one points to where, by number?

options.1: Economic Development is how a place grows its wealth, and who that growth helps or leaves behind
options.2: Economic Development shows up all through the Industrial Revolution, when Britain became much richer than it had ever been before
options.3: In 1776, Adam Smith wrote that ten workers splitting the job could make over 48,000 pins a day (Doc 5)
options.4: Economic Development is in all of the documents, because every document is about making money

hints: Only one of these has a document number in it.
Pointing means a witness, a detail and a number.
items.reason: Option 1 is the definition. Options 2 and 4 never point to a document. Option 3 calls the witness and gives the number: that's where the issue shows.
